units.zh: 禮志上
units.en: Rites Treatise, Part One
units.literal: Treatises on Rites, Part One

units.zh: 〈（案：《禮志序》，原本闕佚。）〉
units.en: (Editor's note: The preface to the Treatise on Rites is no longer extant in the original.)
units.literal: (Note: The preface to the Treatise on Rites is missing from the original text.)

units.zh: 梁開平元年夏四月，太祖初受禪，乃立四廟於西京，從近古之制也。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the first year of Kaiping (907), after the Founding Emperor first accepted the imperial mandate, he established four ancestral temples in the Western Capital, in accordance with recent ancient practice.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the first year of Kaiping of Liang, when the Taizu first received the abdication, he then established four ancestral temples in the Western Capital, following the system of recent antiquity.

units.zh: 唐同光二年六月，太常禮院奏：「國家興建之初，已於北都置廟，今克復天下，遷都洛陽，卻復本朝宗廟。
units.en: In the sixth month of the second year of Tongguang (924), the Ministry of Ceremonies' Court of Imperial Rites submitted a memorial: "When the state was first founded, temples were set up in the Northern Capital. Now that the empire has been recovered and the capital relocated to Luoyang, our dynasty's ancestral temples have been restored.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Tongguang of Tang, the Court of Imperial Rites of the Ministry of Ceremonies memorialized: "At the founding of the state, temples were already established in the Northern Capital. Now that the realm has been recovered and the capital moved to Luoyang, the ancestral temples of our dynasty are restored.

units.zh: 按禮無二廟之文，其北都宗廟請廢。」
units.en: According to ritual precedent, there is no provision for maintaining two ancestral temples; we request that the Northern Capital temples be discontinued."
units.literal: According to ritual, there is no text permitting two sets of temples; the ancestral temples of the Northern Capital are requested to be abolished."

units.zh: 乃下尚書省集議。
units.en: The court then ordered the Secretariat to convene a collective discussion.
units.literal: The matter was then referred to the Secretariat for collective deliberation.

units.zh: 禮部尚書王正言等奏議曰：「伏以都邑之制，宗廟為先。
units.en: Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan and others submitted their opinion: "We respectfully note that in the establishment of a capital, the ancestral temple must come first.
units.literal: Minister of Rites Wang Zhengyan and others submitted a deliberation, saying: "We humbly observe that in the institution of the capital, the ancestral temple takes precedence.

units.zh: 今卜洛居尊，開基禦宇，事當師古，神必依人。
units.en: Now that Luoyang has been chosen by divination and the foundation laid to rule the realm, precedent should be followed—and the spirits will surely dwell where the people are.
units.literal: Now that Luoyang has been divined and the throne established to rule the realm, affairs should follow antiquity, and the spirits will surely attach themselves to the people.

units.zh: 北都先置宗廟，不宜並設。
units.en: The ancestral temple previously established in the Northern Capital ought not to be maintained alongside the new one.
units.literal: The ancestral temple first established in the Northern Capital should not be set up in parallel.

units.zh: 況每年朝享，禮有常規，時日既同，神何所據。
units.en: Moreover, the annual court sacrifices follow established ritual schedules; if the dates are identical, which temple would the spirits attend?
units.literal: Moreover, the annual court sacrifices follow fixed ritual regulations; if the times are the same, upon what would the spirits rely?

units.zh: 竊聞近例，亦有從權。
units.en: We understand that recent precedents have sometimes allowed expedient arrangements as well.
units.literal: We have heard that in recent precedents there have also been expedient measures.

units.zh: 如神主已修，迎之藏於夾室；
units.en: If the spirit tablets have already been prepared, they may be received and stored in the side chambers;
units.literal: If the spirit tablets have already been prepared, they may be welcomed and stored in the side chambers;

units.zh: 若廟宇已崇，虛之以為恒制。
units.en: if the temple buildings have already been erected, they may be left standing empty as a standing practice.
units.literal: if the temple buildings have already been erected, they may be left vacant as a permanent arrangement.

units.zh: 若齊桓公之廟二主，禮無明文，古者師行，亦無遷於廟主。
units.en: As when Duke Huan of Qi kept two ancestral lords in one temple—ritual offers no explicit rule; in antiquity, when armies took the field, spirit tablets were not moved with them either.
units.literal: As when Duke Huan of Qi had two spirit lords in one temple—ritual has no explicit text on this; in antiquity when armies marched, there was also no moving of temple spirit tablets.

units.zh: 昔天後之崇鞏、洛，禮謂非宜；
units.en: In former times Empress Wu's elevation of Gong and Luo was judged improper by ritual standards;
units.literal: In former times the Empress Wu's elevation of Gong and Luo was deemed improper by ritual;

units.zh: 漢皇之戀豐、滕，事無所法。
units.en: and the Han emperor's fondness for Feng and Teng offered no precedent worth following.
units.literal: the Han emperor's attachment to Feng and Teng had no precedent to follow.

units.zh: 況本朝故事，禮院具明，洛邑舊都，嵩高正位，豈宜遠宮闕之居，建祖宗之廟。
units.en: Moreover, our dynasty's precedents have been fully set forth by the Court of Rites. Luoyang is the ancient capital, with Mount Song in its proper place—how could it be fitting to build the ancestral temple far from the palace?
units.literal: Moreover, the precedents of our dynasty have been fully clarified by the Court of Rites; Luoyang is the old capital and Mount Song stands in its proper position—how could it be fitting to build the ancestral temple of forefathers far from the palace residence?

units.zh: 事非可久，理在從長。
units.en: This arrangement cannot endure; reason favors the more lasting course.
units.literal: This matter cannot long continue; the principle lies in adopting the longer-term course.

units.zh: 其北都宗廟，請準太常禮院申奏停廢。」
units.en: We request that the Northern Capital ancestral temple be discontinued, as proposed in the Court of Imperial Rites' memorial."
units.literal: The ancestral temple of the Northern Capital is requested to be discontinued in accordance with the memorial submitted by the Court of Imperial Rites."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 天成元年，中書舍人馬縞奏曰：「伏見漢、晉已來，諸侯王宗室承襲帝統，除七廟之外，皆別追尊親廟。
units.en: In the first year of Tiancheng (926), Secretariat Drafter Ma Gao submitted a memorial, saying: "We respectfully observe that from Han and Jin onward, when feudal princes of the imperial clan succeeded to the throne, apart from the seven temples, collateral temples honoring direct forebears were all separately established.
units.literal: In the first year of Tiancheng, Secretariat Drafter Ma Gao submitted a memorial, saying: "We humbly observe that from Han and Jin onward, when feudal princes of the imperial clan succeeded to the imperial line, apart from the seven temples, collateral temples honoring direct forebears were all separately established.

units.zh: 漢光武皇帝立先四代於南陽，其後桓帝已下，亦皆上考前修，追崇先代。
units.en: Emperor Guangwu of Han established the preceding four generations at Nanyang; thereafter, from Emperor Huan onward, all likewise looked back to earlier precedents and posthumously honored former generations.
units.literal: Emperor Guangwu of Han established the preceding four generations at Nanyang; thereafter from Emperor Huan downward, all likewise looked back to earlier precedents and posthumously honored former generations.

units.zh: 乞依兩漢故事，別立親廟。」
units.en: We beg that, following the precedents of both Han dynasties, collateral temples be separately established."
units.literal: We beg that, following the precedents of the two Han dynasties, collateral temples be separately established."

units.zh: 詔下尚書省，集百官定議。
units.en: An edict was issued to the Secretariat, summoning the hundred officials for collective deliberation.
units.literal: An edict was issued to the Secretariat, summoning the hundred officials for collective deliberation.

units.zh: 禮部尚書蕭頃等議曰：「伏見方冊所載，聖概所存，將達蘋藻之誠，宜有楶棁之制，臣等集議，其追尊位號及建廟都邑，乞特降制命，依馬縞所議。」
units.en: Minister of Rites Xiao Qing and others deliberated, saying: "We respectfully observe what the canonical records preserve and what the sage's intent holds: to express the sincerity of offerings at the ancestral altar, there ought to be an established institution for collateral temples. We your subjects have convened in deliberation; as to the posthumous titles to be honored and the sites at which temples are to be built, we beg that a special decree be issued, following Ma Gao's proposal."
units.literal: Minister of Rites Xiao Qing and others deliberated, saying: "We humbly observe what the canonical records preserve and what the sage's intent holds: to express the sincerity of offerings at the ancestral altar, there ought to be an established rite for collateral temples. We your subjects have convened in deliberation; as to the posthumous titles to be honored and the sites at which temples are to be built, we beg that a special decree be issued, following Ma Gao's proposal."

units.zh: 天成二年，中書門下又上奏：「伏以兩漢以諸侯王入繼帝統，則必易名上謚，廣孝稱皇，載於諸王故事，孝德皇、孝仁皇、孝元皇是也。
units.en: In the second year of Tiancheng (927), the Secretariat again submitted a memorial: "We respectfully note that in both Han dynasties, when a feudal prince succeeded to the throne, his forebears were given new names and posthumous titles, honoring them with the designation Huang in the name of filial piety—as recorded in the precedents on princes, such as Xiaode Huang, Xiaoren Huang, and Xiaoyuan Huang.
units.literal: In the second year of Tiancheng, the Secretariat again submitted a memorial: "We humbly observe that in the two Han dynasties, when a feudal prince succeeded to the imperial line, names were changed and posthumous titles conferred, extending filial piety by the title Huang—recorded in the precedents concerning princes, such as Xiaode Huang, Xiaoren Huang, and Xiaoyuan Huang.

units.zh: 伏乞聖慈，俯從人願，許取皇而薦號，兼上謚以尊名，改置圓陵，仍增兵衛。」
units.en: We humbly ask Your Majesty, in accord with the people's wishes, to permit the title Huang in the conferred designations, together with posthumous titles to honor their names, to relocate their tombs to round burial mounds, and to increase the military guard."
units.literal: We humbly beg Your Sacred Grace to condescend to the people's wish, permitting the use of Huang in conferring titles, together with posthumous titles to honor their names, reestablishing round tombs and increasing military guards."

units.zh: 遂詔太常禮院定其儀制焉。
units.en: An edict was then issued directing the Court of Imperial Rites to establish the appropriate ritual procedures.
units.literal: An edict was then issued ordering the Court of Imperial Rites to determine the ritual regulations.

units.zh: 太常博士王丕等引漢桓帝入嗣，尊其祖河間孝王曰孝穆皇帝、父蠡吾侯曰孝崇皇帝為例，請付太常卿定謚。
units.en: Court of Ceremonies Doctor Wang Pi and others cited as precedent how Emperor Huan of Han, upon succeeding to the throne, honored his grandfather the Filial King of Hejian as Emperor Xiaomu and his father the Marquis of Liwu as Emperor Xiaochong, and asked that the Director of Ceremonies be entrusted with determining the posthumous titles.
units.literal: Doctor of the Court of Ceremonies Wang Pi and others cited as precedent Emperor Huan of Han's succession, honoring his grandfather the Filial King of Hejian as Emperor Xiaomu and his father the Marquis of Liwu as Emperor Xiaochong, and requested that the Director of Ceremonies be charged with determining posthumous titles.

units.zh: 刑部侍郎、權判太常卿馬縞復議曰：「伏準兩漢故事，以諸侯王宗室入承帝統，則必追尊父祖，修樹園陵，西漢宣帝、東漢光武，孝饗之道，故事具存。
units.en: Vice Minister of Justice and Acting Director of Ceremonies Ma Gao submitted a further opinion: "We respectfully follow Han precedent: when a feudal prince of the imperial clan succeeded to the throne, his father and grandfather were invariably honored posthumously and garden tombs established—as with Emperor Xuan of Western Han and Emperor Guangwu of Eastern Han. The practice of filial sacrifice is fully documented in precedent.
units.literal: Vice Minister of Justice and Acting Director of Ceremonies Ma Gao submitted a further deliberation, saying: "We humbly follow the precedents of the two Han dynasties: when a feudal prince of the imperial clan succeeded to the imperial line, father and grandfather were invariably honored posthumously and garden tombs established—Emperor Xuan of Western Han and Emperor Guangwu of Eastern Han; the way of filial sacrifice is fully recorded in precedent.

units.zh: 自安帝入嗣，遂有皇太后令，別崇謚法，追曰某皇，所謂孝德、孝穆之類是也。
units.en: From Emperor An's succession onward, empress dowager edicts established a separate elevated posthumous-title system, posthumously styled as a certain Huang—such as Xiaode and Xiaomu.
units.literal: From the time of Emperor An's succession, there were empress dowager edicts establishing a separate elevated posthumous-title system, posthumously styled as a certain Huang—such as Xiaode and Xiaomu.

units.zh: 前代惟孫皓自烏程侯繼嗣，追父和為文皇帝，事出非常，不堪垂訓。
units.en: In earlier ages only Sun Hao, succeeding from the rank of Marquis of Wucheng, posthumously honored his father He as Emperor Wen—an exceptional case, unfit to serve as a model for posterity.
units.literal: In former ages only Sun Hao, succeeding from Marquis of Wucheng, posthumously honored his father He as Emperor Wen—an extraordinary matter, unfit to serve as instruction.

units.zh: 今據禮院狀，漢安帝以下，若據本紀，又不見「帝」字。
units.en: According to the Court of Rites' report, from Emperor An of Han onward, the basic annals likewise do not use the character Di.
units.literal: Now according to the Court of Rites' report, from Emperor An of Han downward, if one consults the basic annals, the character Di is also not found.

units.zh: 伏以謚法「德象天地曰帝」。
units.en: We respectfully note that according to posthumous-title law, "virtue resembling Heaven and Earth is called Di."
units.literal: We humbly observe that in posthumous-title law, "virtue resembling Heaven and Earth is called Di."

units.zh: 伏緣禮院已曾奏聞，難將兩漢故事，便述尊名，請詔百官集議。」
units.en: Because the Court of Rites has already reported on this matter, it is difficult to apply Han precedent directly in conferring honored titles. We request that Your Majesty order the officials to deliberate collectively."
units.literal: We humbly note that the Court of Rites has already memorialized on this; it is difficult to apply the precedents of the two Han dynasties directly in stating honored names. We request an edict summoning the officials for collective deliberation."

units.zh: 時右僕射李琪等議曰：「伏睹歷代已來，宗廟成制，繼襲無異，沿革或殊。
units.en: At that time Right Vice Director Li Qi and others submitted their opinion: "We respectfully observe that through the ages the ancestral temple has been an established institution; succession has followed a consistent pattern, though details have sometimes varied.
units.literal: At that time Right Vice Director Li Qi and others deliberated, saying: "We humbly observe that through the ages the ancestral temple has been an established institution; succession has been without difference, though modifications have sometimes differed.

units.zh: 馬縞所奏，禮有按據，乞下制命，令馬縞虔依典冊，以述尊名。」
units.en: Ma Gao's proposal has grounding in ritual precedent; we ask that a decree be issued directing Ma Gao to follow the canonical records faithfully in conferring the honored titles."
units.literal: What Ma Gao memorialized has grounding in ritual; we beg that a decree be issued ordering Ma Gao reverently to follow the canonical records in stating the honored names."

units.zh: 時明宗意欲兼加「帝」字，乃下詔曰：「朕聞開國承家，得以制禮作樂，故三皇不相襲，五帝不相沿，隨代創規，於禮無爽。
units.en: At that time Emperor Mingzong wished also to add the character Di, and issued an edict: "We have heard that founding a state and continuing a family lineage permit the establishment of ritual and music; thus the Three Sovereigns did not imitate one another, nor the Five Emperors follow one another's ways—each age created its own regulations without violating ritual propriety.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Mingzong wished also to add the character Di, and issued an edict saying: "We have heard that founding a state and continuing a family lineage permit the establishment of ritual and music; thus the Three Sovereigns did not imitate one another, nor the Five Emperors follow one another's ways—each age created its own regulations, without violating ritual.

units.zh: 矧或情關祖禰，事系烝嘗。
units.en: How much more so when the matter concerns one's forefathers and the seasonal sacrifices offered to them!
units.literal: How much more when feeling concerns forefathers and the recent dead, and affairs touch the seasonal sacrifices!

units.zh: 且追謚追尊，稱皇與帝，既有減增之字，合陳褒貶之辭。
units.en: Moreover, in posthumous titles and honors, both Huang and Di are used; since these titles involve characters of addition and reduction, they ought to convey words of praise and assessment.
units.literal: Moreover, in posthumous titles and posthumous honors, Huang and Di are both used; since there are characters of addition and reduction, words of praise and censure ought to be set forth.

units.zh: 大約二名俱為尊稱，若三皇之代故不可加帝，五帝之代不可言皇。
units.en: Broadly speaking, both titles are honorific designations; in the age of the Three Sovereigns Di could not be added, and in the age of the Five Emperors Huang could not be used.
units.literal: Broadly speaking, both names are honorific titles; in the age of the Three Sovereigns Di could not be added, and in the age of the Five Emperors Huang could not be spoken.

units.zh: 爰自秦朝，便兼二號。
units.en: From the Qin dynasty onward, both titles were used together.
units.literal: From the Qin dynasty onward, both titles were combined.

units.zh: 至若玄元皇帝，事隔千祀，宗追一源，猶顯冊於鴻名，豈須遵於漢典。
units.en: As for the Mysterious Origin Emperor, though a thousand years intervene and the lineage traces to a single source, he still received a grand title in the glorious record—why must one rigidly follow Han precedent?
units.literal: As for the Mysterious Origin Emperor, though a thousand sacrifices intervene and the lineage traces to a single source, he still received a grand title in the glorious record—why must one follow Han canonical precedent?

units.zh: 況朕居九五之位，為億兆之尊，不可總二名於眇躬，惜一字於先代，茍隨執議，何表孝誠！
units.en: Moreover, We occupy the supreme throne, sovereign over the hundred million—We cannot reserve both titles for Our own person while withholding a single character from our forebears; if We merely follow rigid deliberation, how would Our filial devotion be expressed!
units.literal: Moreover, We occupy the position of the nine-and-five, supreme over the hundred million—We cannot combine both titles upon Our slight person and be sparing of a single character for former generations; if We merely follow rigid deliberation, how would filial sincerity be expressed!

units.zh: 可委宰臣與百官詳定，集兩班於中書，逐班各陳所見。」
units.en: Let the chief ministers and all officials deliberate in detail; assemble both court ranks at the Secretariat, and let each rank state its views in turn."
units.literal: The chief ministers and the hundred officials may be entrusted to deliberate in detail; assemble both ranks at the Secretariat, and let each rank in turn state its views."

units.zh: 惟李琪等請於祖禰二室先加「帝」字。
units.en: Li Qi and others alone requested that the character "Di" be added first to the two chambers of the grandfather and the recent forefather.
units.literal: Only Li Qi and others requested that the character "Di" be added first to the two chambers of the grandfather and the recent forefather.

units.zh: 宰臣合眾議奏曰：「恭以朝廷之重，宗廟為先，事系承祧，義符致美。
units.en: The chief ministers, combining the collective deliberation, submitted: "We respectfully observe that in the weight of the court, the ancestral temple comes first; the matter concerns continuing the sacrificial line, and the principle accords with achieving the highest excellence.
units.literal: The chief ministers, combining the collective deliberation, submitted: "We respectfully observe that in the weight of the court, the ancestral temple comes first; the matter concerns continuing the sacrificial line, and the principle accords with achieving perfection.

units.zh: 且聖朝追尊之日，即引漢氏舊儀，在漢氏封崇之時，復依何代故事？
units.en: Moreover, when our sage court posthumously honors forebears, it immediately cites Han ritual precedent—yet when the Han themselves conferred such honors, upon what earlier dynasty's precedent did they rely?
units.literal: Moreover, on the day the sage court posthumously honors, it immediately cites Han old ritual—yet when the Han themselves conferred honor, upon what age's precedent did they rely?

units.zh: 理關凝滯，未協聖謨；
units.en: Rigid adherence to precedent does not accord with Your Majesty's wise design;
units.literal: The principle concerns rigidity and stagnation, and does not accord with the sage design;

units.zh: 道合變通，方為民則。
units.en: flexible adaptation accords with the Way and alone can serve as a standard for the people.
units.literal: the Way accords with flexible adaptation, and only then becomes a standard for the people.

units.zh: 且王者功成治定，制禮作樂，正朔服色，尚有改更，尊祖奉先，何妨沿革。
units.en: Moreover, when a ruler's merit is accomplished and order established, ritual and music are instituted; the calendar, regalia, and ceremonial colors may still be revised—how could honoring ancestors and serving forefathers forbid adaptation?
units.literal: Moreover, when the king's merit is accomplished and order established, ritual and music are instituted; the calendar, regalia, and colors may still be changed—how could honoring ancestors and serving forefathers forbid modification?

units.zh: 若應州必立別廟，即地遠上都。
units.en: If a separate temple must be established at Ying Prefecture, the location would be far from the capital.
units.literal: If a separate temple must be established at Ying Prefecture, the place is far from the supreme capital.

units.zh: 今據開元中追尊臯陶為德明皇帝，涼武昭王為興聖皇帝，皆立廟於京都。
units.en: According to Kaiyuan-era precedent, when Gao Yao was posthumously honored as Emperor Deming and the Martial Illustrious King of Liang as Emperor Xingsheng, temples were established in the capital for both.
units.literal: Now according to the Kaiyuan period, when Gao Yao was posthumously honored as Emperor Deming and the Martial Illustrious King of Liang as Emperor Xingsheng, temples were all established in the capital.

units.zh: 臣等商量所議追尊四廟，望依御劄並加皇帝之號，兼請於洛京立廟。」
units.en: We your subjects, deliberating on the four temples proposed for posthumous honor, ask that in accordance with Your Majesty's rescript the title of emperor be added to all, and that temples be established in the Luoyang capital as well."
units.literal: We your subjects, deliberating on the four temples proposed for posthumous honor, hope in accordance with the imperial rescript to add the title of emperor to all, and also request that temples be established in the Luoyang capital."

units.zh: 敕：「宜於應州舊宅立廟，餘依所奏。」
units.en: Edict: "A temple shall be established at the old residence in Ying Prefecture; the remainder shall follow what was submitted."
units.literal: Edict: "A temple should be established at the old residence in Ying Prefecture; the remainder shall follow what was submitted."

units.zh: 〈（案《文獻通考》：後唐之所謂七廟者，以沙陀之獻祖國昌、太祖克用、莊宗存勖而上繼唐之高祖、太宗、懿宗、昭宗。
units.en: (Editor's note from the Comprehensive Examination of Documents: The so-called seven temples of Later Tang comprised the Shatuo Ancestor Guochang, Taizu Keyong, and Zhuangzong Cunxu, continuing upward with Tang's Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, and Zhaozong.
units.literal: (Note from the Comprehensive Examination of Documents: The so-called seven temples of Later Tang comprised the Shatuo Ancestor Guochang, Taizu Keyong, and Zhuangzong Cunxu, continuing upward with Tang's Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, and Zhaozong.

units.zh: 此所謂四廟者，又明宗代北之高、曾、祖、父也。）〉
units.en: The so-called four temples referred to Mingzong's great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather, grandfather, and father from north of the frontier.)
units.literal: The so-called four temples referred to Mingzong's great-grandfather, great-great-grandfather, grandfather, and father from north of the frontier.)〉

units.zh: 其年八月，太常禮院奏：「莊宗神主以此月十日祔廟，七室之內，合有祧遷。」
units.en: In the eighth month of that year, the Court of Imperial Rites memorialized: "Zhuangzong's spirit tablet is to be enshrined in the ancestral temple on the tenth day of this month; among the seven chambers, a removal to the side altars is required."
units.literal: In the eighth month of that year, the Court of Imperial Rites memorialized: "The spirit tablet of Zhuangzong is to be enshrined in the temple on the tenth day of this month; within the seven chambers there should be a removal to the side altars."

units.zh: 中書門下奏議，請祧懿祖一室。
units.en: The Secretariat submitted its opinion, requesting that the Yizu chamber be removed to the side altars.
units.literal: The Secretariat submitted a deliberation requesting the removal of the Yizu chamber to the side altars.

units.zh: 後下百僚集議，禮部尚書蕭頃等奏，請從中書所奏，從之。
units.en: The court then convened the officials for collective deliberation; Minister of Rites Xiao Qing and others memorialized in favor of the Secretariat's proposal. The request was approved.
units.literal: Later the hundred officials were summoned for collective deliberation; Minister of Rites Xiao Qing and others memorialized requesting that the Secretariat's submission be followed. It was granted.

units.zh: 應順元年正月，中書門下奏：「太常以大行山陵畢祔廟。
units.en: In the first month of the first year of Yingshun (934), the Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Ceremonies reports that upon completion of the late emperor's burial mound, his spirit tablet will be enshrined in the ancestral temple.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yingshun, the Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Ceremonies reports that upon completion of the late emperor's mountain tomb, he will be enshrined in the temple.

units.zh: 今太廟見饗七室，高祖、太宗、懿宗、昭宗、獻祖、太祖、莊宗，大行升祔，禮合祧遷獻祖，請下尚書省集議。」
units.en: The Grand Temple currently maintains seven active chambers: Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong. With the late emperor's enshrinement, ritual requires removing Xianzu to the side altars. We request that the Secretariat convene collective deliberation."
units.literal: The Grand Temple now has seven chambers in active sacrifice: Gaozu, Taizong, Yizong, Zhaozong, Xianzu, Taizu, and Zhuangzong. With the late emperor's enshrinement, ritual requires the removal of Xianzu to the side altars. We request that the Secretariat convene collective deliberation."

units.zh: 太子少傅盧質等議曰：「臣等以親盡從祧，垂於舊典，疑事無質，素有明文。
units.en: Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Lu Zhi and others submitted their opinion: "We hold that when close kinship is exhausted, removal to the side altars applies—this is established in ancient canon; doubtful matters without clear precedent have always been addressed by explicit ritual texts.
units.literal: Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Lu Zhi and others deliberated, saying: "We your subjects hold that when close kinship is exhausted, removal to the side altars follows—this is recorded in ancient canon; doubtful matters without clear precedent have always had explicit texts.

units.zh: 頃莊宗皇帝再造寰區。
units.en: Not long before, Emperor Zhuangzong had restored the empire.
units.literal: Recently Emperor Zhuangzong recreated the realm.

units.zh: 復隆宗廟，追三祖於先遠，復四室於本朝，式遇祧遷，旋成沿革。
units.en: He restored the ancestral temple to prominence, tracing three ancestors to remote antiquity and restoring four chambers to the present dynasty; when removal to the side altars arose, this soon became a precedent for modification.
units.literal: He again elevated the ancestral temple, tracing three ancestors to remote antiquity and restoring four chambers to the present dynasty; encountering removal to the side altars, this soon became a modification.

units.zh: 及莊宗升祔，以懿祖從祧，蓋非嗣立之君，所以先遷其室。
units.en: When Zhuangzong was enshrined, Yizu was removed to the side altars—because he was not a monarch who had directly succeeded to the throne, his chamber was moved first.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong was enshrined, Yizu was removed to the side altars—because he was not a monarch who succeeded directly to the throne, his chamber was moved first.

units.zh: 光武滅新之後，始有追尊之儀，比只在於南陽，元不歸於太廟，引事且疏於故實，此時須稟於新規。
units.en: After Guangwu destroyed the Xin dynasty, posthumous honors were first instituted, but only at Nanyang and never in the Grand Temple; citing this precedent is loose regarding established fact, and the present circumstances require following the new regulations.
units.literal: After Guangwu destroyed Xin, there were first rites of posthumous honor, but these were only at Nanyang and never returned to the Grand Temple; citing this precedent is loose regarding established fact, and at this time one must follow the new regulations.

units.zh: 將來升祔先廟，次合祧遷獻祖，既協隨時之義，又符變體之文。」
units.en: When the late emperor is enshrined in the ancestral temple, Xianzu should next be removed to the side altars—this accords both with adapting to the times and with the ritual texts on flexible modification."
units.literal: When the late emperor is enshrined in the ancestral temple, next Xianzu should be removed to the side altars—this accords both with adapting to the times and with the texts on flexible modification."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 時議以懿祖賜姓於懿宗，以支庶系大宗例，宜以懿祖為始祖，次昭宗可也，不必祖神堯而宗太宗。
units.en: Contemporary opinion held that since Yizu received his surname from Yizong, following the precedent of a collateral line attaching to the major line, Yizu ought to be taken as the founding ancestor, with Zhaozong next—there was no need to take the Divine Yao as ancestor and Taizong as temple founder.
units.literal: Contemporary opinion held that since Yizu received his surname from Yizong, following the precedent of a collateral line attaching to the major line, Yizu ought to be taken as the founding ancestor, with Zhaozong next—there was no need to take Divine Yao as ancestor and Taizong as temple founder.

units.zh: 若依漢光武，則宜於代州立獻祖而下親廟，其唐廟依舊禮行之可也，而議謚者忘咸通之懿宗，又稱懿祖，父子俱「懿」，於理可乎！
units.en: If one followed Han Guangwu's precedent, collateral temples from Xianzu downward should be established at Dai Prefecture, while the Tang temples could follow established ritual—yet those who deliberated on posthumous titles forgot Yizong of the Xiantong era while also styling him Yizu; father and son both bearing "Yi"—is this reasonable!
units.literal: If one followed Han Guangwu, one should establish at Dai Prefecture the collateral temples from Xianzu downward, while the Tang temples could follow old ritual—yet those who deliberated on posthumous titles forgot Yizong of the Xiantong era and also called him Yizu; father and son both bearing "Yi"—is this reasonable!

units.zh: 將朱耶三世與唐室四廟連敘昭穆，非禮之甚也。
units.en: To link three generations of the Zhuaye clan with four Tang temples in continuous zhao-mu sequence is a grave violation of ritual propriety.
units.literal: To link three generations of the Zhuaye with four Tang temples in continuous zhao-mu sequence is a grave violation of ritual.

units.zh: 議祧者不知受氏於唐懿宗而祧之，今又及獻祖。
units.en: Those who deliberated on removal did not realize that Yizu received his clan name from Tang Yizong yet removed his chamber; now they have reached Xianzu as well.
units.literal: Those who deliberated on removal did not know that he received his clan name from Tang Yizong and removed him; now they have reached Xianzu as well.

units.zh: 以禮論之，始祧昭宗，次祧獻祖可也，而懿祖如唐景皇帝，豈可祧乎？
units.en: By ritual propriety, Zhaozong should be removed first, and then Xianzu would be acceptable—but Yizu is like Tang's Jing Emperor; how could his chamber be removed?
units.literal: Speaking in terms of ritual, Zhaozong should be removed first, and then Xianzu would be acceptable—but Yizu is like Tang's Jing Emperor; how could he be removed?

units.zh: 晉天福二年正月，中書門下奏：「皇帝到京，未立宗廟，望令所司速具制度典禮以聞。」
units.en: In the first month of the second year of Tianfu (937), the Secretariat memorialized: "The emperor has arrived at the capital but the ancestral temple has not yet been established; we ask that the responsible offices promptly prepare the institutional regulations and ritual protocols and report back."
units.literal: In the first month of the second year of Tianfu of Jin, the Secretariat memorialized: "The emperor has arrived at the capital but the ancestral temple has not yet been established; we hope the responsible offices will promptly prepare the institutional regulations and ritual protocols and report."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 二月，太常埔士段颙議曰：
units.en: In the second month, Court of Ceremonies Doctor Duan Yong submitted his opinion:
units.literal: In the second month, Court of Ceremonies Doctor Duan Yong deliberated, saying:

units.zh: 夫宗廟之制，歷代為難，須考禮經，以求故事。
units.en: The institution of the ancestral temple has posed difficulties through the ages; one must examine the ritual classics to seek precedents.
units.literal: The institution of the ancestral temple has been difficult through the ages; one must examine the ritual classics to seek precedents.

units.zh: 謹按《尚書·舜典》曰：「正月上日，受終於文祖。」
units.en: We respectfully cite the Canon of Shun in the Documents: "On the first day of the first month, he received the mandate at the temple of his cultured ancestor."
units.literal: We respectfully cite the Canon of Shun in the Documents: "On the first day of the first month, he received the mandate at the temple of his cultured ancestor."

units.zh: 此是堯之廟也，猶未載其數。
units.en: This refers to Yao's temple, yet the number of temples is still not recorded.
units.literal: This was Yao's temple, yet the number is still not recorded.

units.zh: 又按《郊祀錄》曰：夏立五廟，商立六廟，周立七廟。
units.en: We further cite the Record of Suburban Sacrifices: Xia established five temples, Shang six, and Zhou seven.
units.literal: We further cite the Record of Suburban Sacrifices: Xia established five temples, Shang six, and Zhou seven.

units.zh: 漢初立祖宗廟於郡國，共計一百六十七所。
units.en: At the beginning of Han, ancestral temples were established in commanderies and kingdoms, totaling one hundred sixty-seven in all.
units.literal: At the beginning of Han, ancestral temples were established in commanderies and kingdoms, totaling one hundred sixty-seven.

units.zh: 後漢光武中興後，別立六廟。
units.en: After Emperor Guangwu of Later Han restored the dynasty, six temples were separately established.
units.literal: After Guangwu of Later Han restored the dynasty, six temples were separately established.

units.zh: 魏明帝初立親廟四，後重議依周法立七廟。
units.en: Emperor Ming of Wei first established four collateral temples, then after renewed deliberation established seven temples according to Zhou ritual law.
units.literal: Emperor Ming of Wei first established four collateral temples, then after renewed deliberation established seven temples according to Zhou law.

units.zh: 晉武帝受禪，初立六廟，後復立七廟。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Jin accepted the abdication, first establishing six temples, then later establishing seven.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Jin received the abdication, first establishing six temples, then later establishing seven.

units.zh: 宋武帝初立六廟，齊朝亦立六廟。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Song first established six temples; the Qi dynasty also established six.
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Song first established six temples; the Qi dynasty also established six.

units.zh: 隋文帝受命，初立親廟四，至大業元年，煬帝欲遵周法，議立七廟。
units.en: Emperor Wen of Sui received the mandate, first establishing four collateral temples; by the first year of Daye (605), Emperor Yang wished to follow Zhou ritual law and deliberated on establishing seven temples.
units.literal: Emperor Wen of Sui received the mandate, first establishing four collateral temples; by the first year of Daye, Emperor Yang wished to follow Zhou law and deliberated on establishing seven temples.

units.zh: 次屬傳禪於唐，武德元年六月四日，始立四廟於長安，至貞觀九年，命有司詳議廟制，遂立七廟，至開元十一年後，創立九廟。
units.en: Next the mandate passed to Tang; on the fourth day of the sixth month of the first year of Wude (618), four temples were first established at Chang'an; by the ninth year of Zhenguan (635), the responsible offices were ordered to deliberate in detail on the temple system, and seven temples were established; after the eleventh year of Kaiyuan (723), nine temples were created.
units.literal: Next the mandate passed to Tang; on the fourth day of the sixth month of the first year of Wude, four temples were first established at Chang'an; by the ninth year of Zhenguan, the responsible offices were ordered to deliberate in detail on the temple system, and seven temples were established; after the eleventh year of Kaiyuan, nine temples were created.

units.zh: 又按《禮記·喪服小記》曰：「王者禘其祖之所自出，以其祖配之，而立四廟。」
units.en: We further cite the Record of Mourning Garments, Minor Accounts in the Book of Rites: "The king performs the di sacrifice to the source from which his ancestor sprang, pairing his ancestor with it, and establishes four temples."
units.literal: We further cite the Record of Mourning Garments, Minor Accounts in the Book of Rites: "The king performs the di sacrifice to the source from which his ancestor sprang, pairing his ancestor with it, and establishes four temples."

units.zh: 鄭玄註云：高祖巳下至禰四世，即親盡也，更立始祖為不遷之廟，共五廟也。
units.en: Zheng Xuan's commentary states: From Gaozu down to Mi for four generations—that is, when close kinship is exhausted—one further establishes the founding ancestor as the immovable temple, making five temples in all.
units.literal: Zheng Xuan's commentary states: From Gaozu down to Mi for four generations—that is, when close kinship is exhausted—one further establishes the founding ancestor as the immovable temple, making five temples in all.

units.zh: 又按《禮記·祭法》及《王制》、《孔子家語》、《春秋穀梁傳》並云：天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟，士一廟。
units.en: We further cite the Law of Sacrifice in the Book of Rites, the Royal Regulations, the Kongzi Jiayu, and the Guliang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals, all stating: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five, grandees three, and officers one.
units.literal: We further cite the Law of Sacrifice in the Book of Rites, the Royal Regulations, the Kongzi Jiayu, and the Guliang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals, all stating: the Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five, grandees three, and officers one.

units.zh: 此是降殺以兩之義。
units.en: This reflects the principle of descending reduction by twos.
units.literal: This is the principle of descending reduction by twos.

units.zh: 又按《尚書·咸有一德》曰：「七世之廟，可以觀德。」
units.en: We further cite the Consistent Virtue chapter in the Documents: "The temple of seven generations can display virtue."
units.literal: We further cite the Consistent Virtue chapter in the Documents: "The temple of seven generations can display virtue."

units.zh: 又按《疑義》云：天子立七廟，或四廟，蓋有其義也。
units.en: We further cite the Doubtful Points: the Son of Heaven establishes seven temples, or four—each surely has its rationale.
units.literal: We further cite the Doubtful Points: the Son of Heaven establishes seven temples, or four—each surely has its rationale.

units.zh: 如四廟者，從禰至高祖已下親盡，故有四廟之理。
units.en: As for four temples, from Mi down to Gaozu close kinship is exhausted, hence the rationale for four temples.
units.literal: As for four temples, from Mi down to Gaozu close kinship is exhausted, hence the rationale for four temples.

units.zh: 又立七廟者，緣自古聖王，祖有功，宗有德，更封立始祖，即於四親廟之外，或祖功宗德，不拘定數，所以有五廟、六廟，或七廟、九廟，欲後代子孫觀其功德，故《尚書》云「七世之廟，可以觀德」矣。
units.en: As for establishing seven temples, since ancient sage-kings honored ancestors for merit and temple founders for virtue, and further enfeoffed founding ancestors beyond the four collateral temples—whether for ancestral merit or temple-founder virtue, not bound to a fixed number—there arose five, six, seven, or nine temples, so that later descendants might observe their merit and virtue; hence the Documents says, "The temple of seven generations can display virtue."
units.literal: As for establishing seven temples, since ancient sage-kings honored ancestors for merit and temple founders for virtue, and further enfeoffed and established founding ancestors beyond the four collateral temples—whether for ancestral merit or temple-founder virtue, not bound to a fixed number—therefore there are five, six, or seven or nine temples, so that later descendants may observe their merit and virtue; hence the Documents says, "The temple of seven generations can display virtue."

units.zh: 又按周舍論云：「自江左已來，晉、宋、齊、梁相承，多立七廟。」
units.en: We further cite Zhou She's treatise: "Since the establishment of the southern dynasties east of the Yangzi, Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang in succession have mostly established seven temples."
units.literal: We further cite Zhou She's treatise: "Since the east of the Yangzi, Jin, Song, Qi, and Liang in succession have mostly established seven temples."

units.zh: 今臣等參詳，唯立七廟，即並通其理。
units.en: We your subjects, having examined this in detail, hold that establishing seven temples alone comprehends the rationale in both cases.
units.literal: We your subjects, having examined this in detail, hold that establishing only seven temples comprehends the rationale in both cases.

units.zh: 伏緣宗廟事大，不敢執以一理定之，故檢七廟、四廟二件之文，俱得其宜，他所論者，並皆勿取。
units.en: We respectfully note that the ancestral temple is a weighty matter; we dare not fix it by a single rationale alone. Therefore we have examined texts on both seven temples and four temples, finding both appropriate; other proposals should all be set aside.
units.literal: We humbly note that the ancestral temple is a weighty matter; we dare not fix it by a single rationale alone. Therefore we have examined texts on both seven temples and four temples, finding both appropriate; other proposals should all be set aside.

units.zh: 請下三省集百官詳議。
units.en: We request that the Three Departments convene all officials for detailed deliberation.
units.literal: We request that the Three Departments convene the hundred officials for detailed deliberation.

units.zh: 敕旨宜依。
units.en: Imperial rescript: Approved as proposed.
units.literal: Imperial rescript: Approved as proposed.

units.zh: 左僕射劉句等議曰：
units.en: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others submitted their opinion:
units.literal: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others deliberated, saying:

units.zh: 臣等今月八日，伏奉敕命於尚書省集議太常博士段颙所議宗廟事。
units.en: We your subjects, on the eighth day of this month, respectfully received the edict ordering collective deliberation at the Secretariat on the ancestral temple matter proposed by Court of Ceremonies Doctor Duan Yong.
units.literal: We your subjects, on the eighth day of this month, humbly received the edict ordering collective deliberation at the Secretariat on the ancestral temple matter deliberated by Court of Ceremonies Doctor Duan Yong.

units.zh: 伏以將敷至化，以達萬方，克致平和，必先宗廟。
units.en: We humbly consider that to spread the highest virtue to every quarter of the realm and achieve peace and harmony, the ancestral temple must come first.
units.literal: We humbly consider that to spread the utmost transformation and reach the myriad quarters, and to achieve peace and harmony, one must first have the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 故《禮記·王制》云：「天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟。」
units.en: Therefore the Record of Rites: Royal Regulations states: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples, and grand officers three temples."
units.literal: Therefore the 《Record of Rites: Royal Regulations》 says: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples, grand officers three temples."

units.zh: 疏云：「周制之七者，太祖廟及文王、武王之祧，與親廟四。
units.en: The commentary states: "The seven temples of the Zhou system comprise the Taizu temple and the side altars of King Wen and King Wu, together with four collateral-line temples.
units.literal: The commentary says: "The seven of the Zhou system are the Taizu temple and the side altars of King Wen and King Wu, together with four collateral-line temples.

units.zh: 太祖，後稷也。
units.en: The Taizu is Hou Ji.
units.literal: The Taizu is Hou Ji.

units.zh: 商六廟，契及湯與二昭、二穆。
units.en: The Shang had six temples: Qi and Tang, together with two zhao and two mu chambers.
units.literal: The Shang had six temples: Qi and Tang, together with two zhao and two mu chambers.

units.zh: 夏則五廟，無太祖，禹與二昭、二穆而已。
units.en: The Xia had five temples, with no Taizu—only Yu together with two zhao and two mu chambers.
units.literal: The Xia had five temples, with no Taizu—only Yu together with two zhao and two mu chambers.

units.zh: 自夏及周，少不減五，多不過七。」
units.en: From the Xia through the Zhou, the number was never fewer than five and never more than seven."
units.literal: From the Xia through the Zhou, the number was never less than five and never more than seven."

units.zh: 又云：「天子七廟，皆據周也。
units.en: It also states: "The Son of Heaven's seven temples are all based on the Zhou system.
units.literal: It also says: "The Son of Heaven's seven temples are all based on the Zhou system.

units.zh: 有其人則七，無其人則五。
units.en: If the requisite figures exist, there are seven; if they do not, there are five.
units.literal: If the requisite figures exist, there are seven; if they do not, there are five.

units.zh: 若諸侯廟制，雖有其人，則不過五。
units.en: In the feudal lords' temple system, even when the requisite figures exist, the number does not exceed five.
units.literal: In the feudal lords' temple system, even when the requisite figures exist, the number does not exceed five.

units.zh: 此則天子、諸侯七、五之異明矣。」
units.en: Thus the distinction between seven temples for the Son of Heaven and five for feudal lords is clear."
units.literal: Thus the distinction between seven for the Son of Heaven and five for feudal lords is clear."

units.zh: 至於三代已後魏、晉、宋、齊、隋及唐初，多立六廟或四廟，蓋於建國之始，不盈七廟之數也。
units.en: As for the Wei, Jin, Song, Qi, Sui, and early Tang after the Three Dynasties, many established six or four temples—at the founding of a state the number did not yet reach seven.
units.literal: As for the Wei, Jin, Song, Qi, Sui, and early Tang after the Three Dynasties, many established six temples or four temples—at the founding of a state the number did not yet reach seven.

units.zh: 今欲請立自高祖已下四親廟，其始祖一廟，未敢輕議，伏俟聖裁。
units.en: We now propose to establish four collateral-line temples from Gaozu downward; as for a separate founding-ancestor temple, we dare not discuss it lightly and humbly await Your Sacred Majesty's decision.
units.literal: We now propose to establish four collateral-line temples from Gaozu downward; as for a separate founding-ancestor temple, we dare not discuss it lightly and humbly await Your Sacred Majesty's decision.

units.zh: 御史中丞張昭遠奏議曰：
units.en: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan submitted his memorial and deliberation:
units.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan submitted a memorial and deliberation, saying:

units.zh: 臣前月中預都省集議宗廟事，伏見議狀於親廟之外，請別立始祖一廟，近奏中書門下牒，再令百官於都省議定聞奏者。
units.en: Last month I participated when the Capital Secretariat convened collective deliberation on the ancestral temple; I saw in the submitted deliberation that, beyond the collateral temples, a separate founding-ancestor temple was proposed. The Secretariat has recently issued a dispatch ordering all officials again to deliberate at the Capital Secretariat and report back.
units.literal: Last month I participated when the Capital Secretariat convened collective deliberation on the ancestral temple; I saw in the submitted deliberation that, beyond the collateral temples, a separate founding-ancestor temple was proposed. The Secretariat has recently issued a dispatch ordering the hundred officials again to deliberate at the Capital Secretariat and report.

units.zh: 臣讀十四代史書，見二千年故事，觀諸家宗廟，都無始祖之稱，唯商、周二代，以稷、契為太祖。
units.en: I have read the histories of fourteen dynasties and reviewed two thousand years of precedent; in every dynasty's ancestral temples there is no title of founding ancestor—only in the Shang and Zhou were Ji and Qi taken as Taizu.
units.literal: I have read the histories of fourteen dynasties and reviewed two thousand years of precedent; in every dynasty's ancestral temples there is no title of founding ancestor—only in the Shang and Zhou were Ji and Qi taken as Taizu.

units.zh: 《禮記》曰：「天子七廟，三昭、三穆，與太祖之廟而七。」
units.en: The Record of Rites states: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Taizu temple—seven in all."
units.literal: The 《Record of Rites》 says: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples: three zhao, three mu, and the Taizu temple—seven in all."

units.zh: 鄭玄註：「此周制也。
units.en: Zheng Xuan's annotation: "This is the Zhou system.
units.literal: Zheng Xuan's annotation: "This is the Zhou system.

units.zh: 七者，太祖後稷及文王、武王與四親廟。」
units.en: The seven are the Taizu Hou Ji, Kings Wen and Wu, and the four collateral-line temples."
units.literal: The seven are the Taizu Hou Ji, Kings Wen and Wu, and the four collateral-line temples."

units.zh: 又曰：「商人六廟，契及成湯與二昭、二穆也。
units.en: It further states: "The Shang had six temples: Qi and Cheng Tang, together with two zhao and two mu chambers.
units.literal: It further says: "The Shang had six temples: Qi and Cheng Tang, together with two zhao and two mu chambers.

units.zh: 夏後氏立五廟，不立太祖，惟禹與二昭、二穆而已。」
units.en: The Xia Hou clan established five temples and did not establish a Taizu—only Yu together with two zhao and two mu chambers."
units.literal: The Xia Hou clan established five temples and did not establish a Taizu—only Yu together with two zhao and two mu chambers."

units.zh: 據《王制》鄭玄所釋，即商、周以稷、契為太祖，夏後無太祖，亦無追謚之廟。
units.en: According to Zheng Xuan's explanation of the Royal Regulations, the Shang and Zhou took Ji and Qi as Taizu; the Xia Hou had no Taizu and also no posthumously enshrined temple.
units.literal: According to Zheng Xuan's explanation of the 《Royal Regulations》, the Shang and Zhou took Ji and Qi as Taizu; the Xia Hou had no Taizu and also no posthumously enshrined temple.

units.zh: 自商、周以來，時更十代，皆於親廟之中，以有功者為太祖，無追崇始祖之例。
units.en: Since the Shang and Zhou, ten dynasties have passed; all, within the collateral temples, took the meritorious figure as Taizu—there is no precedent for posthumously honoring a founding ancestor.
units.literal: Since the Shang and Zhou, ten dynasties have passed; all, within the collateral temples, took the meritorious figure as Taizu—there is no precedent for posthumously honoring a founding ancestor.

units.zh: 具引今古，即恐詞繁，事要證明，須陳梗概。
units.en: To cite ancient and modern cases in full would make the language prolix; since the matter requires proof, I must set forth the outline.
units.literal: To cite ancient and modern cases in full would make the language prolix; since the matter requires proof, I must set forth the outline.

units.zh: 漢以高祖父太上皇執嘉無社稷功，不立廟號，高帝自為高祖。
units.en: The Han, because the great-grandfather the Supreme Emperor Zhijia had no merit for the state, did not establish a temple title; the High Emperor himself served as Gaozu.
units.literal: The Han, because the great-grandfather the Supreme Emperor Zhijia had no merit for the altars of soil and grain, did not establish a temple title; the High Emperor himself served as Gaozu.

units.zh: 魏以曹公相漢，垂三十年，始封於魏，故為太祖。
units.en: The Wei, because Duke Cao served as chancellor of Han for nearly thirty years and was first enfeoffed in Wei, made him Taizu.
units.literal: The Wei, because Duke Cao served as chancellor of Han for nearly thirty years and was first enfeoffed in Wei, made him Taizu.

units.zh: 晉以宣王輔魏有功，立為高祖，以景帝始封晉，故為太祖。
units.en: The Jin, because the Xuan King assisted Wei with merit, established him as Gaozu; because the Jing Emperor was first enfeoffed in Jin, he was made Taizu.
units.literal: The Jin, because the Xuan King assisted Wei with merit, established him as Gaozu; because the Jing Emperor was first enfeoffed in Jin, he was made Taizu.

units.zh: 宋氏先世，官閥卑微，雖追崇帝號，劉裕自為高祖。
units.en: The Song clan's earlier generations were of humble official standing; although imperial titles were posthumously conferred, Liu Yu himself served as Gaozu.
units.literal: The Song clan's earlier generations were of humble official standing; although imperial titles were posthumously conferred, Liu Yu himself served as Gaozu.

units.zh: 南齊高帝之父，位至右將軍，生無封爵，不得為太祖，高帝自為太祖。
units.en: The Southern Qi Gaodi's father rose to Right General; in life he received no enfeoffment and could not be Taizu—the Gaodi himself served as Taizu.
units.literal: The Southern Qi Gaodi's father rose to Right General; in life he received no enfeoffment and could not be Taizu—the Gaodi himself served as Taizu.

units.zh: 梁武帝父順之，佐佑齊室，封侯，位至領軍、丹陽尹，雖不受封於梁，亦為太祖。
units.en: Liang Wudi's father Shunzhi assisted the Qi court, was enfeoffed as marquis, and rose to Area Commander and Danyang Intendant; although he received no enfeoffment from Liang, he was made Taizu.
units.literal: Liang Wudi's father Shunzhi assisted the Qi court, was enfeoffed as marquis, and rose to Area Commander and Danyang Intendant; although he received no enfeoffment from Liang, he was made Taizu.

units.zh: 陳武帝父文贊，生無名位，以武帝功，梁室贈侍中，封義興公，及武帝即位，亦追為太祖。
units.en: Chen Wudi's father Wenzan had no rank in life; because of the Wudi's merit, the Liang court posthumously granted him Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him as Duke of Yixing; when the Wudi ascended the throne, he was also posthumously made Taizu.
units.literal: Chen Wudi's father Wenzan had no rank in life; because of the Wudi's merit, the Liang court posthumously granted him Palace Attendant and enfeoffed him as Duke of Yixing; when the Wudi ascended the throne, he was also posthumously made Taizu.

units.zh: 周閔帝以父泰相西魏，經營王業，始封於周，故為太祖。
units.en: Northern Zhou Emperor Min, because his father Tai served as chancellor of Western Wei, built the royal enterprise, and was first enfeoffed in Zhou, made him Taizu.
units.literal: Northern Zhou Emperor Min, because his father Tai served as chancellor of Western Wei and built the royal enterprise and was first enfeoffed in Zhou, made him Taizu.

units.zh: 隋文帝父忠，輔周室有大功，始封於隋，故為太祖。
units.en: Sui Wendi's father Zhong assisted the Zhou court with great merit and was first enfeoffed in Sui; therefore he was made Taizu.
units.literal: Sui Wendi's father Zhong assisted the Zhou court with great merit and was first enfeoffed in Sui; therefore he was made Taizu.

units.zh: 唐高祖神堯祖父虎為周八柱國，隋代追封唐公，故為太祖。
units.en: Tang Gaozu Shenyao's grandfather Hu was one of the Zhou Eight Pillars; the Sui dynasty posthumously enfeoffed him as Duke of Tang; therefore he was made Taizu.
units.literal: Tang Gaozu Shenyao's grandfather Hu was one of the Zhou Eight Pillars; the Sui dynasty posthumously enfeoffed him as Duke of Tang; therefore he was made Taizu.

units.zh: 唐末梁室朱氏有帝位，亦立四廟，朱公先世無名位，雖追冊四廟，不立太祖，朱公自為太祖。
units.en: At the end of Tang the Liang Zhu clan held the imperial throne and also established four temples; the Zhu lord's earlier generations had no rank; although four temples were posthumously enrolled, no Taizu was established—the Zhu lord himself served as Taizu.
units.literal: At the end of Tang the Liang Zhu clan held the imperial throne and also established four temples; the Zhu lord's earlier generations had no rank; although four temples were posthumously enrolled, no Taizu was established—the Zhu lord himself served as Taizu.

units.zh: 此則前代追冊太祖，不出親廟之成例也。
units.en: This shows that in former ages posthumous enrollment as Taizu did not depart from the established precedent of the collateral temples.
units.literal: This shows that in former ages posthumous enrollment as Taizu did not depart from the established precedent of the collateral temples.

units.zh: 王者祖有功而宗有德，漢、魏之制，非有功德不得立為祖宗，商、周受命，以稷、契有大功於唐、虞之際，故追尊為太祖。
units.en: The king takes as ancestor one with merit and as temple founder one with virtue; in the Han and Wei systems, without merit and virtue one could not be established as ancestor or temple founder. When the Shang and Zhou received the Mandate, because Ji and Qi had great merit in the era of Tang and Yu, they were posthumously honored as Taizu.
units.literal: The king takes as ancestor one with merit and as temple founder one with virtue; in the Han and Wei systems, without merit and virtue one could not be established as ancestor or temple founder. When the Shang and Zhou received the Mandate, because Ji and Qi had great merit in the era of Tang and Yu, they were posthumously honored as Taizu.

units.zh: 自秦、漢之後，其禮不然，雖祖有功，仍須親廟。
units.en: From the Qin and Han onward, the rite was not so; even when one was taken as ancestor for merit, one still had to be within the collateral temples.
units.literal: From the Qin and Han onward, the rite was not so; even when one was taken as ancestor for merit, one still had to be within the collateral temples.

units.zh: 今亦粗言往例，以取證明。
units.en: I will now briefly state former precedents to serve as proof.
units.literal: I will now briefly state former precedents to serve as proof.

units.zh: 秦稱造父之後，不以造父為始祖；
units.en: The Qin claimed descent from Zaofu but did not take Zaofu as founding ancestor;
units.literal: The Qin claimed descent from Zaofu but did not take Zaofu as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 漢稱唐堯、劉累之後，不以堯、累為始祖；
units.en: the Han claimed descent from Tang Yao and Liu Lei but did not take Yao and Lei as founding ancestors;
units.literal: the Han claimed descent from Tang Yao and Liu Lei but did not take Yao and Lei as founding ancestors;

units.zh: 魏稱曹參之後，不以參為始祖；
units.en: the Wei claimed descent from Cao Shen but did not take Shen as founding ancestor;
units.literal: the Wei claimed descent from Cao Shen but did not take Shen as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 晉稱趙將司馬卬之後，不以卬為始祖；
units.en: the Jin claimed descent from Zhao general Sima Ang but did not take Ang as founding ancestor;
units.literal: the Jin claimed descent from Zhao general Sima Ang but did not take Ang as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 宋稱漢楚元王之後，不以元王為始祖；
units.en: the Song claimed descent from Han's Prince Yuan of Chu but did not take the Prince Yuan as founding ancestor;
units.literal: the Song claimed descent from Han's Prince Yuan of Chu but did not take the Prince Yuan as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 齊、梁皆稱蕭何之後，不以蕭何為始祖；
units.en: the Qi and Liang both claimed descent from Xiao He but did not take Xiao He as founding ancestor;
units.literal: the Qi and Liang both claimed descent from Xiao He but did not take Xiao He as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 陳稱太丘長陳寔之後，不以實為始祖；
units.en: the Chen claimed descent from Taqiu Prefect Chen Shi but did not take Shi as founding ancestor;
units.literal: the Chen claimed descent from Taqiu Prefect Chen Shi but did not take Shi as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 元魏稱李陵之後，不以陵為始祖；
units.en: Northern Wei claimed descent from Li Ling but did not take Ling as founding ancestor;
units.literal: Northern Wei claimed descent from Li Ling but did not take Ling as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 後周稱神農之後，不以神農為始祖；
units.en: Later Zhou claimed descent from Shennong but did not take Shennong as founding ancestor;
units.literal: Later Zhou claimed descent from Shennong but did not take Shennong as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 隋稱楊震之後，不以楊震為始祖；
units.en: the Sui claimed descent from Yang Zhen but did not take Yang Zhen as founding ancestor;
units.literal: the Sui claimed descent from Yang Zhen but did not take Yang Zhen as founding ancestor;

units.zh: 唐稱臯陶、老子之後，不以臯陶、老子為始祖。
units.en: the Tang claimed descent from Gao Yao and Laozi but did not take Gao Yao and Laozi as founding ancestors.
units.literal: the Tang claimed descent from Gao Yao and Laozi but did not take Gao Yao and Laozi as founding ancestors.

units.zh: 唯唐高宗則天武後臨朝，革唐稱周，又立七廟，仍追冊周文王姬昌為始祖，此蓋當時附麗之徒，不諳故實，武立姬廟，乖越已甚，曲臺之人，到今嗤誚。
units.en: Only when Empress Wu held court during the reigns of Tang Gaozong and herself—changing the dynasty from Tang to Zhou, establishing seven temples, and posthumously enfeoffing King Wen of Zhou, Ji Chang, as Founding Ancestor—did such a thing occur. This was the work of sycophants ignorant of historical precedent; Empress Wu's establishment of a temple to the Ji clan was egregiously irregular, and ritual scholars of the Quetai still mock it to this day.
units.literal: Only when Empress Wu held court during the reigns of Tang Gaozong and herself—changing Tang to Zhou, again establishing seven temples, and still posthumously enfeoffing King Wen of Zhou, Ji Chang, as Founding Ancestor—was this done; this was surely the hangers-on of that time who did not understand ancient facts; Wu establishing a Ji temple was already greatly transgressive, and men of the Quetai to this day mock and ridicule it.

units.zh: 臣遠觀秦、漢，下至周、隋，禮樂衣冠，聲明文物，未有如唐室之盛。
units.en: Looking back from Qin and Han down through Northern Zhou and Sui, in ritual, music, vestments, renown, and cultural splendor, nothing matched the magnificence of the Tang dynasty.
units.literal: Your subject, looking far from Qin and Han down to Northern Zhou and Sui, in ritual music, caps and robes, reputation and brilliance, and cultural institutions—none matched the grandeur of the Tang house.

units.zh: 武德議廟之初，英才間出，如溫、魏、顏、虞通今古，封、蕭、薛、杜達禮儀，制度憲章，必有師法。
units.en: At the outset of the Wude-era deliberations on temple rites, outstanding talents emerged in succession—Wen, Wei, Yan, and Yu mastered past and present learning; Feng, Xiao, Xue, and Du were versed in ritual; institutions and statutes must surely have had authoritative precedents to follow.
units.literal: At the beginning when temples were deliberated in the Wude era, outstanding talents appeared in succession—such as Wen, Wei, Yan, and Yu, who mastered past and present; Feng, Xiao, Xue, and Du, who mastered ritual propriety; institutions and statutes surely had masters to follow.

units.zh: 夫追崇先王、先母之儀，起於周代。
units.en: The rites of posthumously honoring former kings and former mothers originated in the Zhou dynasty.
units.literal: Now, the rites of posthumously honoring former kings and former mothers originated in the Zhou dynasty.

units.zh: 據《史記》及禮經云：「武王纘太王、王季、文王之緒，一戎衣而有天下，尊為天子，宗廟饗之。
units.en: According to the Records of the Grand Historian and the ritual classics: "King Wu continued the lineage of Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen; clad in armor he seized the realm, was enthroned as Son of Heaven, and received sacrifice in the ancestral temple.
units.literal: According to the Records of the Grand Historian and the ritual classics it says: "King Wu continued the thread of Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen; with one suit of armor he obtained the realm, was honored as Son of Heaven, and the ancestral temple received sacrifice for him.

units.zh: 周公成文、武之德，追王太王、王季，祀先公以天子之禮。」
units.en: The Duke of Zhou fulfilled the virtue of Wen and Wu, posthumously honoring Grand King and King Ji as kings, and sacrificed to the former lords with the rites of Son of Heaven."
units.literal: The Duke of Zhou completed the virtue of Wen and Wu, posthumously enking Grand King and King Ji, and sacrificed to the former lords with the rites of Son of Heaven."

units.zh: 又曰「郊祀後稷以配天。」
units.en: It also says, "In suburban sacrifice, Hou Ji was offered as counterpart to Heaven."
units.literal: It also says: "In suburban sacrifice, Hou Ji was matched with Heaven."

units.zh: 據此言之，周武雖祀七世，追為王號者，但四世而已。
units.en: From this it follows that although King Wu of Zhou sacrificed to seven generations, only four generations received posthumous royal titles.
units.literal: According to this, although Zhou Wu sacrificed to seven generations, those posthumously given kingly titles were only four generations.

units.zh: 故自東漢以來，有國之初，多崇四廟，從周制也。
units.en: Therefore, from the Eastern Han onward, dynasties at their founding mostly established four temples, following Zhou practice.
units.literal: Therefore from the Eastern Han onward, at the founding of a state, four temples were mostly honored—following Zhou institutions.

units.zh: 況商因夏禮，漢習秦儀，無勞博訪之文，宜約已成之制。
units.en: Moreover, the Shang adopted Xia ritual and the Han inherited Qin ceremony—there is no need for exhaustive textual inquiry; we should adhere to institutions already established.
units.literal: Moreover, Shang adopted Xia ritual; Han followed Qin ceremony—there is no need for wide-ranging inquiry of texts; one should adhere to established institutions.

units.zh: 請依隋、唐有國之初，創立四廟，推四世之中名位高者為太祖。
units.en: We request that, following the practice of Sui and Tang at their founding, four temples be established, with the most eminent figure among the four generations designated as Great Ancestor.
units.literal: We request that according to the founding of Sui and Tang states, four temples be newly established, and that among the four generations the one of highest name and rank be designated as Great Ancestor.

units.zh: 謹議以聞。
units.en: We respectfully submit this opinion for the emperor's consideration.
units.literal: We respectfully submit this deliberation for report.

units.zh: 敕：宜令尚書省集百官，將前議狀與張昭遠所陳，速定奪聞奏。
units.en: Edict: The Secretariat shall assemble the officials, take the previous deliberation together with Zhang Zhaoyuan's submission, and promptly reach a decision and report back.
units.literal: Edict: The Secretariat should be ordered to assemble the hundred officials, take the previous deliberation document together with what Zhang Zhaoyuan submitted, and quickly decide and report.

units.zh: 左僕射劉句等再議奏曰：
units.en: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others submitted a further deliberation, saying:
units.literal: Left Vice Director Liu Gou and others again submitted a deliberation, saying:

units.zh: 臣等今月十三日，再於尚書省集百官詳議。
units.en: On the thirteenth day of this month, we again convened the officials at the Secretariat for detailed deliberation.
units.literal: We your subjects on the thirteenth day of this month again assembled the hundred officials at the Secretariat for detailed deliberation.

units.zh: 夫王者祖武宗文，郊天祀地，故有追崇之典，以申配饗之儀。
units.en: Kings take martial achievement as their ancestral model and cultural virtue as their object of veneration; in sacrificing to Heaven and earth, there are thus rites of posthumous honor to express the ceremony of matched sacrifice.
units.literal: Now, kings take martial prowess as ancestor and cultural achievement as object of veneration; in sacrificing to Heaven and earth, therefore there are rites of posthumous honor to express the ceremony of matched sacrifice.

units.zh: 初詳太常禮院議狀，唯立七廟四廟，即並通其理。
units.en: Upon first examining the Court of Imperial Rites deliberation, its proposals regarding seven temples and four temples both accord with established principle.
units.literal: Upon first examining the Court of Imperial Rites deliberation, only the establishment of seven temples and four temples both comprehend its principle.

units.zh: 其他所論，並皆勿取。
units.en: All other points raised shall be set aside.
units.literal: All other points discussed shall none be adopted.

units.zh: 七廟者，按《禮記·王制》曰：「天子七廟，三昭、三穆與太祖之廟而七。」
units.en: As for seven temples, the Record of Rites, "Royal Regulations" states: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples—three zhao, three mu, and the Great Ancestor's temple, making seven."
units.literal: As for seven temples, according to the Record of Rites, "Royal Regulations" it says: "The Son of Heaven has seven temples—three zhao, three mu, and the temple of the Great Ancestor, making seven."

units.zh: 鄭玄註云：「此周制也。」
units.en: Zheng Xuan commented: "This is the Zhou institution."
units.literal: Zheng Xuan's commentary says: "This is the Zhou institution."

units.zh: 詳其禮經，即是周家七廟之定數。
units.en: A close reading of the ritual classics shows this to be the fixed number of seven temples for the Zhou house.
units.literal: Examining the ritual classics in detail, this is the fixed number of seven temples for the house of Zhou.

units.zh: 四廟者，謂高、曾、祖、禰四世也。
units.en: As for four temples, these are the four generations of great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.
units.literal: As for four temples, this means the four generations of great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.

units.zh: 按《周本紀》及《禮記·大傳》皆曰：「武王即位，追王太王、王季、文王。
units.en: The "Basic Annals of Zhou" and the Record of Rites, "Great Tradition" both state: "When King Wu took the throne, he posthumously honored Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen as kings.
units.literal: According to the "Basic Annals of Zhou" and the Record of Rites, "Great Tradition," both say: "When King Wu took the throne, he posthumously enking Grand King, King Ji, and King Wen.

units.zh: 以後稷為堯稷官，故追尊為太祖。」
units.en: Because Hou Ji had served Yao as Minister of Agriculture, he was posthumously honored as Great Ancestor."
units.literal: Because Hou Ji was the Minister of Agriculture under Yao, he was therefore posthumously honored as Great Ancestor."

units.zh: 此即周武王初有天下，追尊四廟之明文也。
units.en: This is explicit textual evidence that when King Wu of Zhou first obtained the realm, he posthumously honored four temples.
units.literal: This is the explicit text of Zhou King Wu's posthumous honoring of four temples when he first obtained the realm.

units.zh: 故自嘆、魏已降，迄於周、隋，創業之君，追謚不過四世，約周制也。
units.en: Therefore, from Han and Wei onward through Northern Zhou and Sui, founding rulers posthumously honored no more than four generations—a practice modeled on Zhou institutions.
units.literal: Therefore from Han and Wei downward, down to Northern Zhou and Sui, founding rulers' posthumous titles did not exceed four generations—approximating Zhou institutions.

units.zh: 此禮行之已久，事在不疑。
units.en: This rite has long been established; there should be no doubt about it.
units.literal: This rite has long been practiced; the matter admits no doubt.

units.zh: 今參詳都省前議狀，請立四廟外，別引始祖，取裁未為定議。
units.en: In reviewing the Metropolitan Secretariat's earlier deliberation, apart from proposing four temples, it also separately invoked a Founding Ancestor—a point on which imperial decision has not yet been settled.
units.literal: Now, examining the previous deliberation document of the Metropolitan Secretariat, apart from requesting four temples, separately citing a Founding Ancestor—the imperial decision has not yet been a fixed deliberation.

units.zh: 續準敕據御史中丞張昭遠奏，請創立四廟之外，無別封始祖之文。
units.en: Subsequently, in accordance with the edict and Zhang Zhaoyuan's memorial as Vice Censor-in-Chief, beyond proposing four temples, there was no provision for separately enfeoffing a Founding Ancestor.
units.literal: Subsequently, in accordance with the edict and based on Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Zhaoyuan's memorial, apart from requesting the establishment of four temples, there was no text separately enfeoffing a Founding Ancestor.

units.zh: 況國家禮樂刑名，皆依唐典，宗廟之制，須約舊章。
units.en: Moreover, our state's ritual, music, penal law, and regulations all follow Tang precedent; the ancestral temple system must conform to established statutes.
units.literal: Moreover, the state's ritual, music, penal codes, and regulations all follow Tang canon; the ancestral temple system must adhere to former statutes.

units.zh: 請依唐朝追尊獻祖宣皇帝、懿祖光皇帝、太祖景皇帝、代祖元皇帝故事，追尊四廟為定。
units.en: We request that, following Tang precedent in posthumously honoring Xianzu Emperor Xuan, Yizu Emperor Guang, Taizu Emperor Jing, and Daizu Emperor Yuan, the enshrinement of four temples be established as fixed policy.
units.literal: We request that according to Tang precedent in posthumously honoring Xianzu Emperor Xuan, Yizu Emperor Guang, Taizu Emperor Jing, and Daizu Emperor Yuan, the posthumous honoring of four temples be fixed.

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: It was granted.

units.zh: 七年七月，太常禮院奏：「國朝見饗四廟：靖祖、肅祖、睿祖、憲祖。
units.en: In the seventh month of the seventh year, the Court of Imperial Rites memorialized: "Our dynasty currently maintains four active temples: Jingzu, Suzu, Ruizu, and Xianzu.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year, the Court of Imperial Rites memorialized: "Our dynasty now has four temples in active sacrifice: Jingzu, Suzu, Ruizu, and Xianzu.

units.zh: 今大行皇帝將行升祔，按《會要》：唐武德元年，立四廟於長安；
units.en: The late emperor is about to be enshrined. According to the Institutional Essentials: in the first year of Wude (618), Tang established four temples in Chang'an;
units.literal: Now the late emperor will undergo enshrinement; according to the Institutional Essentials: in the first year of Wude of Tang, four temples were established in Chang'an;

units.zh: 貞觀九年，高祖神堯皇帝崩，命有司詳議廟制，議以高祖神主並舊四室祔廟。
units.en: In the ninth year of Zhenguan (635), Gaozu the Divine and Yao Emperor died; officials were ordered to deliberate on temple rites in detail, and it was decided that Gaozu's spirit tablet would be enshrined alongside the existing four chambers.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Zhenguan, Gaozu the Divine and Yao Emperor died; officials were ordered to deliberate on the temple system in detail; it was decided that Gaozu's spirit tablet together with the old four chambers would be enshrined in the temple.

units.zh: 今先帝神主，請同唐高祖升祔。」
units.en: We request that the late emperor's spirit tablet be enshrined by the same procedure as Tang Gaozu."
units.literal: Now the former emperor's spirit tablet is requested to be enshrined the same as Tang Gaozu's ascent."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: It was granted.

units.zh: 漢天福十二年閏七月，時漢高祖已即位，尚仍天福之號。
units.en: In the intercalary seventh month of the twelfth year of Tianfu (947), Han Gaozu had already ascended the throne but still used the Tianfu era name.
units.literal: In the intercalary seventh month of the twelfth year of Tianfu of Han, at this time Han Gaozu had already taken the throne but still used the Tianfu era name.

units.zh: 太常博士段颙奏議曰：「伏以宗廟之制，歷代為難，須按禮經，旁求故實，又緣禮貴隨時，損益不定。
units.en: Ritual specialist Duan Yong submitted his opinion: "We respectfully note that ancestral temple rites have posed difficulties in every age; one must follow the ritual classics and consult historical precedent. Moreover, ritual values timely adaptation, so additions and subtractions are not fixed.
units.literal: Chamberlain for Ceremonial Affairs Duan Yong submitted a deliberation, saying: "We humbly observe that the ancestral temple system has been difficult through the generations; one must follow the ritual classics and broadly seek ancient facts; moreover, because ritual values adapting to the times, additions and subtractions are not fixed.

units.zh: 今參詳歷代故事，立高、曾、祖、禰四廟，更上追遠祖光武皇帝為始祖百代不遷之廟，居東向之位，共為五廟，庶符往例，又合禮經。」
units.en: Having reviewed precedents from successive dynasties, we propose establishing four temples for the four immediate generations, and further posthumously honoring the remote ancestor Emperor Guangwu as Founding Ancestor in an immovable temple facing east—a total of five temples—which would accord with past practice and conform to the ritual classics."
units.literal: Now, examining precedents through the generations, establishing four temples for great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father, and further upward posthumously honoring remote ancestor Emperor Guangwu as Founding Ancestor in a temple undisturbed for a hundred generations, occupying the east-facing position, together making five temples—this would accord with past precedent and also conform to the ritual classics."

units.zh: 詔尚書省集百官議。
units.en: The emperor ordered the Secretariat to convene the officials for deliberation.
units.literal: An edict ordered the Secretariat to assemble the hundred officials to deliberate.

units.zh: 吏部尚書竇貞固等議云：「按《禮記·王制》云：「天子七廟，諸侯五廟，大夫三廟。」
units.en: Minister of the Civil Office Dou Zhengu and others submitted their opinion: "According to the Record of Rites, 'Royal Regulations': 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five, and grandees three.'
units.literal: Minister of the Civil Office Dou Zhengu and others deliberated, saying: "According to the Record of Rites, 'Royal Regulations,' it says: 'The Son of Heaven has seven temples, feudal lords five temples, grandees three temples.'

units.zh: 疏云：「周制之七廟者，太祖及文王、武王之祧，與親廟四。
units.en: The commentary states: the seven temples of Zhou comprise the Great Ancestor, the side altars of King Wen and King Wu, and four close-kin temples.
units.literal: The commentary says: as for the seven temples of Zhou institutions, the Great Ancestor and the side altars of King Wen and King Wu, together with four close temples.

units.zh: 太祖，后稷也。」
units.en: The Great Ancestor is Hou Ji.
units.literal: The Great Ancestor is Hou Ji.

units.zh: 又云：「天子七廟，皆據周也。
units.en: It also states: the Son of Heaven's seven temples all follow the Zhou model.
units.literal: It also says: the seven temples of the Son of Heaven are all based on Zhou.

units.zh: 有其人則七，無其人則五。」
units.en: If the requisite ancestors exist, there are seven; if not, five.
units.literal: If there are such persons, then seven; if there are not such persons, then five.

units.zh: 至於光武中興及歷代多立六廟或四廟，蓋建國之始，未盈七廟之數。
units.en: As for Emperor Guangwu's restoration and successive dynasties that established six or four temples—at a state's founding, the full complement of seven temples was usually not yet reached.
units.literal: As for Guangwu's restoration and through successive generations many established six temples or four temples—at the founding of a state, the number of seven temples was not yet filled.

units.zh: 又按《郊祀錄》王肅云：「德厚者流澤廣，天子可以事六代之義也。」
units.en: Moreover, according to the Record of Suburban Sacrifices, Wang Su stated: "Those of profound virtue extend their beneficence widely; the Son of Heaven may sacrifice to six generations."
units.literal: Moreover, according to the Record of Suburban Sacrifices, Wang Su says: "Those of thick virtue extend broad beneficence; the Son of Heaven may serve six generations in meaning."

units.zh: 今欲請立高祖已下四親廟。
units.en: We now propose establishing four close-kin temples from Gaozu downward.
units.literal: Now it is desired to request establishing four close temples from Gaozu downward.

units.zh: 又自古聖王，祖有功，宗有德，即於四親廟之外，祖功宗德，不拘定數。
units.en: Moreover, from antiquity sage kings have enshrined those who achieved merit and honored those who possessed virtue; beyond the four close-kin temples, such honors of merit and virtue were never confined to a fixed count.
units.literal: Moreover, since ancient sage kings: they temple those of merit and honor those of virtue; beyond the four close temples, honoring merit and virtue is not bound by a fixed number.

units.zh: 今除四親廟外，更請上追高皇帝、光武皇帝，更立六廟。」
units.en: Apart from the four close-kin temples, we further request posthumously honoring the Supreme Emperor and Emperor Guangwu, bringing the total to six temples."
units.literal: Now, apart from the four close temples, it is further requested to posthumously honor upward Supreme Emperor and Emperor Guangwu, and to establish six temples in all."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 〈（《文獻通考》：莊宗、明宗既舍其祖而祖唐之祖矣，及敬瑭、知遠崛起而登帝位，俱欲以華胄自詭，故於四親之外，必求所謂始祖而祖之。
units.en: (From the Comprehensive Examination of Documents: Zhuangzong and Mingzong had already abandoned their own forebears to honor Tang's ancestors; when Jingtang and Zhiyuan seized the throne, each sought to disguise himself as scion of a great Chinese house, and so beyond the four close-kin temples they always hunted out a so-called Founding Ancestor to enshrine.
units.literal: (From the Comprehensive Examination of Documents: Zhuangzong and Mingzong had already set aside their own ancestors to venerate Tang's ancestors; when Jingtang and Zhiyuan rose to the throne, both wished to pass themselves off as of noble Chinese pedigree, and so beyond the four close kin they necessarily sought a so-called Founding Ancestor to venerate.

units.zh: 張昭之言，議正而詞偉矣。
units.en: Zhang Zhao's argument was sound and his language magnificent.
units.literal: Zhang Zhao's words—the reasoning was correct and the diction lofty.

units.zh: 至漢初，則段颙、竇貞固之徒，曲為諂附，乃至上祖高、光，以為六廟雲。）〉
