units.en: By the opening of Han, men such as Duan Yong and Dou Zhengu bent the rites into sycophancy, even enshrining Gaozu and Guangwu above the rest to make six temples.)
units.literal: But at the beginning of Han, figures such as Duan Yong and Dou Zhengu twisted matters into flattery, going so far as to venerate Gaozu and Guangwu upward, making six temples and such.)

units.zh: 周廣順元年正月，中書門下奏：「太常禮院議，合立太廟室數。
units.en: In the first month of the first year of Guangshun (951), the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Rites has deliberated on how many chambers the imperial ancestral temple should contain.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Guangshun of Zhou, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Rites deliberated on the number of ancestral temple chambers that ought to be established.

units.zh: 若守文繼體，則魏、晉有七廟之文；
units.en: For rulers who inherit an established order, Wei and Jin provide precedent for seven temples;
units.literal: If inheriting and maintaining written tradition, Wei and Jin have texts on seven temples;

units.zh: 若創業開基，則隋、唐有四廟之議。
units.en: For founders who rise from nothing, Sui and Tang offer deliberations on four temples.
units.literal: If founding an enterprise and establishing a base, Sui and Tang have deliberations on four temples.

units.zh: 聖朝請依近禮，追謚四廟。
units.en: Our dynasty proposes to follow recent practice and posthumously enshrine four temples.
units.literal: Our sacred dynasty requests following recent rites to posthumously enshrine four temples.

units.zh: 伏恐所議未同，請下百官集議。」
units.en: We fear the deliberations may not yet be unanimous and request that all officials be convened to discuss the matter."
units.literal: We humbly fear the deliberations may not agree; we request dispatching all officials to assemble and deliberate."

units.zh: 太子太傅和凝等議：「請據禮官議，立四親廟。」
units.en: Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent He Ning and others argued: "We ask that four close-kin temples be established according to the rites officials' recommendation."
units.literal: Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent He Ning and others deliberated: "We request basing ourselves on the rites officials' deliberation to establish four close temples."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：和凝議曰：「恭以肇啟洪圖，惟新黃屋。
units.en: (From the Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties: He Ning argued: "Reverently, Your Majesty has opened a great enterprise and renewed the imperial throne.
units.literal: (From the Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties: He Ning deliberated, saying: "Reverently, having first opened the vast design and renewed the yellow canopy.

units.zh: 左宗廟而右社稷，率由舊章；
units.en: The ancestral temple placed to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right—all according to ancient statute;
units.literal: The ancestral temple to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right—all following old statutes;

units.zh: 崇祖禰而辨尊卑，載於前史。
units.en: Honoring forebears and fathers while distinguishing rank and precedence is recorded in the histories of old.
units.literal: Honoring ancestors and fathers while distinguishing high and low—is recorded in former histories.

units.zh: 雖質文互變，義趣各殊，或觀損益之規，或系興隆之始。
units.en: Though substance and ornament shift with the ages and each case has its own rationale, sometimes one reads rules of addition and reduction, sometimes the very origin of a dynasty's rise.
units.literal: Though substance and ornament alternate in change and meanings differ in each case, sometimes one observes rules of addition and subtraction, sometimes one ties to the beginning of rise and flourishing.

units.zh: 陛下體元立極，本義祖仁，開變家成國之基，遵奉先思孝之道，合據禮官議，立四親廟，以葉前文。」
units.en: Your Majesty embodies the primal origin and stands as supreme pole, taking righteousness as root and benevolence as guide, laying the foundation by which a household became a realm and honoring forebears in filial devotion. It is altogether fitting to follow the rites officials' recommendation, establish four close-kin temples, and harmonize with earlier precedent."
units.literal: Your Majesty embodies the primal origin and establishes the supreme pole, rooting in righteousness and taking benevolence as ancestor, opening the foundation of transforming a house into a state, following and revering forebears in the way of filial piety—altogether basing on the rites officials' deliberation to establish four close temples, to accord with earlier words."

units.zh: 從之。）〉
units.en: The proposal was approved.)
units.literal: The request was granted.)

units.zh: 其年四月，中書門下奏：「太常禮院申，七月一日，皇帝御崇元殿，命使奏冊四廟。
units.en: In the fourth month of that year, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Rites reports that on the first day of the seventh month the emperor will preside in the Hall of Glorious Origins and commission envoys to present the enshrinement registers for the four temples.
units.literal: In the fourth month of that year, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Rites reports that on the first day of the seventh month the emperor will attend the Hall of Glorious Origins and order envoys to present the registers for the four temples.

units.zh: 準舊儀，服兗冕即座，太尉引冊案入，皇帝降座，引立於御座前南向，中書令奉冊案進，皇帝搢珪捧授，冊使跪受，轉授舁冊官，其進寶授寶儀如冊案。
units.en: Under the old protocol, the emperor wears the nine-linked crown and takes his seat; the Grand Commandant leads in the register table; the emperor descends and is conducted to stand facing south before the throne; the Director of the Secretariat advances the register table; the emperor inserts his scepter and presents it; the register envoy kneels to receive it and passes it to the bearers; the ceremony for presenting and conferring the seal follows the same procedure as for the register.
units.literal: According to old protocol: wearing the nine-linked crown, take the seat; the Grand Commandant leads the register table in; the emperor descends from the seat and is led to stand south-facing before the imperial seat; the Director of the Secretariat presents the register table; the emperor inserts the scepter and hands it over; the register envoy kneels to receive, then transfers it to the register-bearers; the protocol for presenting and handing over the seal follows that of the register table.

units.zh: 臣等參詳，至時請皇帝降階授冊。」
units.en: We have reviewed the matter in detail and request that, when the time comes, the emperor descend the steps to confer the register himself."
units.literal: We your ministers have examined in detail; at the time we request that the emperor descend the steps to present the register."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 三年九月，將有事於南郊，議於東京別建太廟。
units.en: In the ninth month of the third year, with a southern-suburb sacrifice impending, officials deliberated building a separate imperial ancestral temple at the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, when the southern suburb ceremony was to be performed, it was deliberated to separately build an imperial ancestral temple at the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 時太常禮院言：「準洛京廟室一十五間，分為四室，東西各有夾室，四神門，每方屋一間，各三門，戟二十四，別有齋宮神廚屋宇。
units.en: The Court of Imperial Rites reported: "According to the Luoyang model, the temple comprises fifteen bays divided into four main chambers, with side chambers on east and west, four spirit gates, one bay per cardinal direction with three gates each, twenty-four halberds, and separate buildings for the fasting palace and spirit kitchen.
units.literal: At the time the Court of Imperial Rites said: "According to the Luoyang capital, the temple chambers number fifteen bays, divided into four chambers; east and west each have side chambers; four spirit gates; each direction has one bay with three gates each; twenty-four halberds; separately there are fasting-palace and spirit-kitchen buildings.

units.zh: 準禮，左宗廟，右社稷，在國城內，請下所司修奉。」
units.en: By rite the ancestral temple stands to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right, within the capital walls; we request that the responsible offices be ordered to restore and maintain them."
units.literal: According to rites, the ancestral temple is to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right, within the capital walls; we request dispatch to the relevant offices to restore and maintain them."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 其月，太常禮院奏：「迎太廟社稷神主到京，其日未審皇帝親出郊外迎奉否。
units.en: That same month, the Court of Imperial Rites memorialized: "When the spirit tablets of the imperial ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain are brought to the capital, it remains undecided whether the emperor should personally go out beyond the city to receive them.
units.literal: That month, the Court of Imperial Rites memorialized: "When welcoming the spirit tablets of the imperial ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain to the capital, it is not yet determined whether on that day the emperor will personally go out beyond the suburbs to receive them.

units.zh: 檢討故事，元無禮例，伏請召三省官集議。」
units.en: A search of precedents turns up no established ritual; we humbly request that officials of the Three Departments be convened to deliberate."
units.literal: Examining precedents, originally there is no ritual example; we humbly request summoning the Three Departments' officials to assemble and deliberate."

units.zh: 敕：「宜令尚書省四品以上、中書門下五品已上同參議。」
units.en: An edict ordered: "Officials of the fourth rank and above in the Secretariat, together with officials of the fifth rank and above in the Secretariat and Chancellery, shall jointly deliberate."
units.literal: An edict: "It is fitting to order officials of the fourth rank and above in the Secretariat and of the fifth rank and above in the Secretariat and Chancellery to participate jointly in deliberation."

units.zh: 司徒竇貞固、司空蘇禹珪等議：「按吳主孫休即位，迎祖父神主於吳郡，人祔太廟，前一日出城野次，明日常服奉迎，此其例也。」
units.en: Minister over the Masses Dou Zhengu, Minister of Works Su Yugui, and others argued: "When Sun Xiu of Wu took the throne, he welcomed his grandfather's spirit tablet from Wu Commandery for enshrinement in the ancestral temple; the day before he went out of the city and encamped in the open country, and the next day received the tablet in ordinary dress. That is the precedent."
units.literal: Minister over the Masses Dou Zhengu, Minister of Works Su Yugui, and others deliberated: "According to the precedent when Lord Sun Xiu of Wu acceded, he welcomed his grandfather's spirit tablet from Wu Commandery and had it enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple; the day before he went out of the city to encamp in the open country, and the next day in ordinary dress received and escorted it—this is the example."

units.zh: 遂署狀言車駕出城奉迎為是，請下禮儀使草定儀註。
units.en: They then signed a memorial recommending that the emperor go out of the city to receive the tablets, and requested that the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol draft the ceremonial regulations.
units.literal: Thereupon they signed a memorial stating that the imperial carriage going out of the city to receive and escort was correct, and requested dispatch to the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol to draft the ritual regulations.

units.zh: 至十月，禮儀使奏：「太祖神主將至，前一日儀仗出城掌次，於西禦莊東北設神主行廟幄幕，面南。
units.en: In the tenth month, the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol memorialized: "When Taizu's spirit tablet is about to arrive, on the preceding day the guard of honor will go out of the city to prepare the encampment, and a traveling-temple canopy for the spirit tablet shall be erected northeast of the Western Imperial Estate, facing south.
units.literal: By the tenth month, the Commissioner of Ritual Protocol memorialized: "When Taizu's spirit tablet is about to arrive, on the day before the guard of honor goes out of the city to manage the encampment, a traveling-temple canopy for the spirit tablet is set up northeast of the Western Imperial Estate, facing south.

units.zh: 其日放朝，群臣早出西門，皇帝常服出城詣行宮，群臣起居畢，就次。
units.en: On that day court is suspended; the officials assemble early at the Western Gate; the emperor goes out of the city in ordinary dress to the traveling palace; after the officials have paid their respects, they take their stations.
units.literal: On that day court is dismissed; the hundred officials go out early through the Western Gate; the emperor in ordinary dress goes out of the city to the traveling palace; when the hundred officials have finished paying respects, they take their places.

units.zh: 神主將至，群臣班定，皇帝立於班前。
units.en: As the spirit tablet approaches, the officials form their ranks and the emperor stands before them.
units.literal: When the spirit tablet is about to arrive, the hundred officials' ranks are set; the emperor stands before the ranks.

units.zh: 神主至，太常卿請皇帝再拜，群臣俱拜。
units.en: When the spirit tablet arrives, the Director of the Court of Imperial Rites asks the emperor to bow twice, and all the officials bow with him.
units.literal: When the spirit tablet arrives, the Director of the Court of Imperial Rites requests the emperor to bow twice; the hundred officials all bow.

units.zh: 神主就行廟幄幕座，設常饌，群臣班於神幄前。
units.en: The spirit tablet is conducted to its seat in the traveling-temple canopy; ordinary offerings are laid out, and the officials form ranks before the spirit canopy.
units.literal: The spirit tablet proceeds to the seat within the traveling-temple canopy; ordinary offerings are set out; the hundred officials rank before the spirit canopy.

units.zh: 侍中就次，請皇帝謁神主。
units.en: The Palace Attendant takes his station and asks the emperor to approach the spirit tablet.
units.literal: The Palace Attendant takes his place and requests the emperor to visit the spirit tablet.

units.zh: 既至，群臣再拜，皇帝進酒畢再拜，群臣俱拜。
units.en: When he arrives, the officials bow twice; after the emperor presents wine and bows again, all the officials bow with him.
units.literal: When he has arrived, the hundred officials bow twice; when the emperor has finished presenting wine he bows twice again; the hundred officials all bow.

units.zh: 皇帝還幄，群臣先赴太廟門外立班，俟皇帝至起居。
units.en: The emperor returns to the canopy; the officials go ahead to form ranks outside the ancestral temple gate and wait for the emperor to arrive and pay his respects.
units.literal: The emperor returns to the canopy; the hundred officials first go to stand in ranks outside the gate of the imperial ancestral temple, awaiting the emperor's arrival to pay respects.

units.zh: 俟神主至，群臣班於廟門外，皇帝立於班前，太常卿請皇帝再拜，群臣俱拜。
units.en: When the spirit tablet arrives, the officials form ranks outside the temple gate; the emperor stands before them; the Director of the Court of Imperial Rites asks the emperor to bow twice, and all the officials bow with him.
units.literal: Awaiting the spirit tablet's arrival, the hundred officials rank outside the temple gate; the emperor stands before the ranks; the Director of the Court of Imperial Rites requests the emperor to bow twice; the hundred officials all bow.

units.zh: 皇帝還幄，群臣就次，宮闈令安神主於本室訖，群臣班於廟庭。
units.en: The emperor returns to the canopy and the officials take their stations; the Director of the Inner Palace installs the spirit tablet in its proper chamber; when this is done, the officials form ranks in the temple courtyard.
units.literal: The emperor returns to the canopy; the hundred officials take their places; the Director of the Inner Palace installs the spirit tablet in its proper chamber; when finished, the hundred officials rank in the temple courtyard.

units.zh: 太常卿請皇帝於四室奠饗，逐室皇帝再拜，群臣俱拜。
units.en: The Director of the Court of Imperial Rites asks the emperor to offer sacrifice in each of the four chambers; at every chamber the emperor bows twice and all the officials bow with him.
units.literal: The Director of the Court of Imperial Rites requests the emperor to set out offerings and feast in the four chambers; at each chamber the emperor bows twice and the hundred officials all bow.

units.zh: 四室祔饗畢，皇帝還宮。
units.en: When the enshrinement offerings in all four chambers are complete, the emperor returns to the palace.
units.literal: When the enshrinement feasting in the four chambers is finished, the emperor returns to the palace.

units.zh: 前件儀註，望付中書門下宣下。」
units.en: We request that these ritual regulations be issued through the Secretariat and Chancellery."
units.literal: The foregoing ritual regulations are requested to be transmitted by the Secretariat and Chancellery for promulgation."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: The request was granted.

units.zh: 顯德六年七月，詔以大行皇帝山陵有期，神主將祔太廟，其廟殿室宇合添修否？
units.en: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Xiande (959), an edict asked: with the late emperor's tomb already scheduled and his spirit tablet about to be enshrined in the ancestral temple, should the temple halls and chambers be expanded or renovated?
units.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Xiande, an edict stated that because the late emperor's imperial tomb had a set date and his spirit tablet was about to be enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple, ought the temple halls and chambers to be added to or renovated?

units.zh: 國子司業兼太常博士聶崇義奏議曰：「奉敕，為大行皇帝山陵有期，神主祔廟，恐殿室間數少，合重添修。
units.en: Nie Chongyi, Vice Director of the Directorate of Education and concurrent Erudite of the Court of Imperial Rites, memorialized: "By imperial order: with the late emperor's tomb already scheduled and his spirit tablet to be enshrined, we fear the temple lacks sufficient chambers and should be expanded or renovated.
units.literal: Vice Director of the Directorate of Education and Concurrent Erudite of the Court of Imperial Rites Nie Chongyi memorialized in deliberation, saying: "Receiving the edict: because the late emperor's imperial tomb has a set date and his spirit tablet will be enshrined in the temple, we fear the number of hall chambers is too few and ought to be added to or renovated again.

units.zh: 今詣廟中相度，若是添修廟殿一間至兩間，並須移動諸神門及角樓宮墻仗舍，及堂殿正面檐栿階道，亦須東省牲立班位，直至齋宮，漸近迫窄。
units.en: Having inspected the temple, we find that adding even one or two bays to the main hall would require relocating the spirit gates, corner towers, palace walls, guard quarters, and the hall's front eaves, beams, and steps; the eastern slaughtering ground and the officials' standing ranks would also have to be moved, right up to the fasting palace—making the whole precinct ever more cramped.
units.literal: Now, going to the temple to measure: if one adds or renovates one to two bays of the temple hall, it would all require moving the various spirit gates, corner towers, palace walls, guard quarters, and the main hall's front eaves, beams, and steps; it would also require shifting the eastern slaughtering ground and the ranks for standing in formation, all the way to the fasting palace—gradually drawing near and pressing narrow.

units.zh: 今重拆廟殿，續更添修，不唯重勞，兼恐未便。
units.en: Demolishing the hall again for further expansion would not only impose great labor but may prove impracticable.
units.literal: Now to demolish the temple hall again and continue adding and renovating would not only be doubly laborious, but we also fear it would not be convenient.

units.zh: 竊見廟殿見虛東西二夾室，況未有祧遷之主，欲請不拆廟殿，更添間數，即便將夾室重安排六室位次。
units.en: I note that the main hall already has vacant side chambers on east and west, and that no ancestor has yet been removed by distant enshrinement; I propose leaving the hall intact, adding no new bays, and instead rearranging the six chamber positions within the side chambers.
units.literal: I privately observe that the temple hall presently has vacant east and west side chambers; moreover, there is not yet a lord subject to removal by distant enshrinement; I wish to request not demolishing the temple hall or adding bays, but immediately rearranging the six chamber positions within the side chambers.

units.zh: 所有動移神主，若準舊禮，於殿庭權設行廟幕殿，即恐雨水猶多，難於陳設。
units.en: To move the spirit tablets, old rite would set up a provisional traveling-temple canopy in the courtyard—but rain is still frequent at this season, making that arrangement difficult.
units.literal: As for moving the spirit tablets, if according to old rites a traveling-temple canopy hall is provisionally set up in the temple courtyard, we fear rain is still frequent and it would be difficult to arrange.

units.zh: 伏請權於太廟齋宮內奉安神主，至修奉畢日，庶為宜稱。
units.en: We humbly propose temporarily installing the spirit tablets in the temple's fasting palace until renovations are complete, which would be the most suitable course.
units.literal: We humbly request provisionally installing the spirit tablets within the fasting palace of the imperial ancestral temple until the day restoration and maintenance are finished—then it would be fitting and appropriate.

units.zh: 又，按《禮記》云：廟成則於中屋刲羊以釁之，夾室則用雞。
units.en: Moreover, the Record of Rites states: when a temple is completed, a sheep is slaughtered in the central chamber to consecrate it; side chambers require a chicken.
units.literal: Moreover, according to the 《Record of Rites》 it says: when the temple is completed, a sheep is slaughtered in the central chamber to consecrate it; for side chambers a chicken is used.

units.zh: 又，《大戴禮》及《通典》亦有夾室，察文觀義，乃是備廟之制。
units.en: The Records of the Elder Dai and the Comprehensive Institutions likewise mention side chambers; read in context, these belong to the institution of reserve temple chambers.
units.literal: Moreover, the 《Records of the Elder Dai》 and the 《Comprehensive Institutions》 also have side chambers; examining the text and observing the meaning, this is the system of reserve temples.

units.zh: 況新主祔廟，諸經有遷易之文，考古沿今，庶合通禮。
units.en: When a new spirit tablet is enshrined, the classics provide for rearrangement and transfer; weighing antiquity against present practice, this would accord with established ritual.
units.literal: Moreover, when a new lord is enshrined in the temple, the various classics have texts on transfer and change; examining antiquity and following the present, this would broadly accord with universal rites.

units.zh: 伏請遞遷諸室奉安大行皇帝神主，以符禮意。」
units.en: We humbly request that the chambers be rearranged in sequence to install the late emperor's spirit tablet, in keeping with ritual propriety."
units.literal: We humbly request sequentially transferring the chambers to install the late emperor's spirit tablet, to accord with ritual meaning."

units.zh: 敕依典禮。
units.en: An edict ordered compliance with the canonical rites.
units.literal: An edict followed the canonical rites.
